page.layout: One page of verse in one column. Running head top centre, page number top right. Above the rule: the end of a stanza from the previous part. Below the rule: a centred division heading "QVINTA PARS.", then verse stanzas. Gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: Invisum & meritis crimina diluet Poenis turpia: quum suo Gens impura cadet subruta tempore. Ultrix nam scelerum dies Improvisa ruens cladibus asperis Plebes conteret impias. Vindex poena cito iam properat pede.
main_text.head: QVINTA PARS.
main_text.p: VErum potentis robore brachij Pacatus Abrae progeniem Deus Servabit, & duris fidelem Rebus opem feret innocatus.
Postquam flagellis fracta ferocibus Fastus rebelles pectore territo Deponet: occultúmque aperto Corde nefas procul omne tollet.
Atque execrandis ritibus abstinens Pura Supremum mente colet Patrem Experta quam vanum profesta Numen ament,celebrentque Gentes.
Nam quid nefandis pinguia Damonum Edisse mensis fercula proderit: Et vina libantem rogasse Foeda nigro simulachra fumo?
Opémne sanis casibus afferant Eidola nullis praedita viribus: Divique queis mortalis audax

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side (faint text at right and lower left) left out. Doubtful readings: "profesta" (as printed, possibly profesta for professa); "Damonum" as printed, for Daemonum; "occultúmque" with accent as printed. Possible printing error: "Numen ament,celebrentque" has no space after the comma, copied as printed. The last stanza runs over the page end; its continuation is on the next page.
